mapper.select: SELECT p.abs_id, p.delegate_id, u.user_name as delegateUserName, to_char(p.start_dt,'YYYY-MM-DD') as startDt, to_char(p.end_dt,'YYYY-MM-DD') as endDt, p.proxy_comment, p.seq_no FROM T2000_PROXY p join t1000_account a on p.delegate_id=a.account_id join t1000_user u on a.user_no=u.user_no WHERE p.abs_id = #{accountId} AND p.DEL_YN = 'N' and p.end_dt > SYSDATE ORDER BY p.SEQ_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T2000_PROXY (ABS_ID, DELEGATE_ID, START_DT, END_DT, PROXY_COMMENT, DEL_YN) VALUES (#{absId}, #{delegateId}, TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{endDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{proxyComment}, 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT p.abs_id, p.delegate_id, u.user_name as delegateUserName, to_char(p.start_dt,'YYYY-MM-DD') as startDt, to_char(p.end_dt,'YYYY-MM-DD') as endDt, p.proxy_comment, p.seq_no FROM T2000_PROXY p join t1000_account a on p.delegate_id=a.account_id join t1000_user u on a.user_no=u.user_no WHERE p.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo}
mapper.update: update T2000_PROXY set delegate_id=#{delegateId}, start_dt=#{startDt}, end_dt=#{endDt}, proxy_comment=#{proxyComment}, update_dt=SYSDATE where seq_no=#{seqNo} and abs_id=#{absId}
update T2000_PROXY set del_Yn = 'Y', update_dt=SYSDATE where seq_no=#{seqNo}
